# Fluento - AI Language Learning

Fluento is a personalized AI language teacher that leverages "Student Digital Twin" technology and Learning Analytics to master new languages through immersion.

## Core Features
- **AI Coach**: Personalized pedagogical guidance based on your learning profile.
- **Student Digital Twin**: A virtual model of your learning progress, strengths, and weaknesses.
- **Real-world Missions**: Immersive scenarios to practice speaking in natural contexts.
- **Learning Analytics**: Deep insights into your fluency, vocabulary retention, and grammar mastery.
- **Adaptive Planning**: Lessons that evolve with your progress and confidence levels.

## Important Pages
- [Home](https://fluento.ai/): Product overview and features.
- [Pricing](https://fluento.ai/pricing): Subscription plans and free trial information.

## Technology Stack
Fluento is built with a DDD (Domain-Driven Design) architecture, utilizing React for the frontend and a secure Express backend for AI orchestrations.
